title: ai chart values
description: Constrains only what a template cannot see on its own: helm validates this before any template renders, so a reclaim cost that is not a positive whole number fails the render instead of landing in the head-end config as a string or a zero. Everything else in this chart's values is deliberately unconstrained - the guards that compare two values live in the templates that read both.

reclaimCostSeconds.description: Seconds to put this model's card back the way it was: measured cold start plus a full re-prefill. null or absent means this host never measured it, which is not the same as zero.
